text:
Nina K.: Company card declined at check-in in Porto. Hotel wouldn't accept swipe for pre-auth. I'm on a business trip — can I pay personally and get reimbursed? Also they put a "guest fee" on folio for partner who slept one night. :grimacing:

Ella (People Ops): Sorry for the hassle. Yes, pay personally if the company card fails. Collect the itemized folio (room + folio lines) and any authorization failure screenshot. Submit in Ramp within 7 days and tag 'travel' + 'lodging'. Partner/guest fees are only reimbursable if pre-authorized as business guest.

Nina K.: I have folio pdf and a photo of the CC terminal error. Paid €120. How should I split the receipt for the guest portion?

Ben - Travel Ops: Split line items if folio shows guest charge separately. If not, attach a short note in Ramp explaining allocation and include boarding pass/itinerary. For EU hotels, ask bookings to set hold limit to €300 to avoid declines.

Sam (Finance): Submit with category Lodging, code EXP-LODG-TRV. If you mark 'urgent' we'll process faster (same-day push if finance approves). For reimbursement via ACH, include last 4 of bank account. FX fees: reimburseable if company card or when personal payment made due to auth fail — include bank statement showing fee.

Travel Bot: Per policy, partner/guest charges are non-reimbursable unless documented as client or business guest. Link: https://redwood.com/policies/travel :warning:

Marta: FYI check your Ramp profile currency settings — if set to USD sometimes foreign auths decline. Also, some hotels don't accept virtual cards for pre-auth.

Nina K.: Submitted Ramp claim 176900A with folio, terminal_error.jpg, and comment 'paid personally due to company card auth failure; spouse stayed but not company guest; requesting room portion only'. Marked urgent.

Sam (Finance): Got it. I'll review and flag for expedited approval. Ella, note manual approval for guest split. If you need an advance next time, ping me before check-in and I can issue a one-off virtual card.

Ella (People Ops): Noted. For record: spouse charge excluded. Approved for room reimbursement once finance clears. Thanks for quick upload.

Nina K.: Thanks team :pray:

Ben - Travel Ops: Postmortem tip: add note in Concur/booking saying 'pre-auth limit 300 EUR' for Iberia/EU city hotels; avoids this. Also keep terminal screenshots — helps finance.

Travel Bot: Reminder: expenses submitted >7 days after trip may be denied. Keep receipts attached. :calendar:

Nina K.: All set — appreciate the help :thumbsup:
